title: Zeta Zeros and the Exact Growth of Signed Liouville Energies
description: The complete manuscript incorporates a fixed deterministic completely multiplicative construction with all logarithmic savings and maximal Abel vanishing but an energy exponent 2 max(Theta,beta), plus rigidity of the exact Abel coefficient. RH and GRH remain open.
